mapper.select:
SELECT a.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, /**资产代码(金融产品代码)**/ b.FINPROD_ABBR AS finprodAbbr, /**资产全称(金融产品简称)**/ a.INPUT_TYPE AS valueSource, /**估值来源**/ a.VAL_DATE AS valueDate, /**估值日期**/ a.VALUATION AS valueAsset /**资产净值**/ FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION a left JOIN FIN_PRODUCT b ON a.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID and a.FINPROD_TYPE = b.FINPROD_TYPE WHERE 1=1 and b.PROFIT_TYPE in ('01','03') and a.FINPROD_TYPE='F17'
AND a.FINPROD_ID in
#{item}
AND b.FINPROD_ABBR LIKE '%' || #{finprodAbbr} || '%'
AND a.VAL_DATE >= to_date(#{valueDateBegin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND a.VAL_DATE <= to_date(#{valueDateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
select FINPROD_ID code, FINPROD_ABBR name, FINPROD_ABBR shortName, FINPROD_ID hidCode from FIN_PRODUCT where PROFIT_TYPE in ('01','03') and FINPROD_TYPE='F17'
mapper.delete: delete from FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and VAL_DATE = to_date(#{valueDate} ,'yyyy-MM-dd') and FINPROD_TYPE= 'F17'
mapper.select: select FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_TYPE from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId} and FINPROD_TYPE='F17'
